goals.title: The wing that remembers every crash
goals.critique: This is round 23's wing, and it fixes the two faults named there. The wing that keeps every scar makes the flyer Lumi's own and not Learn to Fly's catapult toy, and places that give you materials turn the single distance axis into a map that changes what you can build. 'No two wings alike after ten crashes' is a hook people would describe the game by, and a spar breaking where the beam stress really exceeded the cane's strength is exactly the honest failure the human asks for. The weak side is a tension the pitch never resolves. Every patch adds weight, so a wing that is half patches should fly worse than a fresh one, and nothing says why ten repairs carry Lumi further than one good build. If the answer is only better materials from the far places, the scars are decoration and the repair loop becomes chores. 'Heavier here, stiffer there, you feel it' also only means something if the wing bends under its air load and the bent shape feeds back into the lift. That is a coupled aeroelastic solver hidden inside the vortex-lattice step of the road, and it is the first thing that will get faked with a mass offset. The pig as ballast is a one-off gag, and the road puts Lumi jumping fourth, so the first several steps are a glider on a bench with no bird in it.
